messages.body: Alex, final walkthrough done. We'll be deducting $350 from your deposit for the wall damage in the back bedroom. The rest goes out this week.

note.text: The move-in inspection report already listed the back bedroom wall damage, and Victor signed that report.

question: How should I respond to the deduction?
fact: The bedroom wall damage was already recorded on the move-in inspection report that Victor signed, so it predates the tenancy.
